lineage.traffic: gold/v2_forecast/traffic_5min (LAM raw, non-faulty vehicles at 0-200 km/h, faulty_vehicles for the outage check)

definition.volume: vehicles in the local hour (non-faulty, 0-200 km/h)
definition.median_speed_kmh: median of the hour's 5-minute mean speeds (windows with vehicles); null without vehicles
definition.observed_share: per station (both directions): share of the twelve 5-minute windows that are observed; a window is missing when absent from the data or when the station has no vehicles at all in it (faulty included) although its median for that day type and hour is at least 6; null = no data that day
definition.incomplete: observed_share under 80% (outage or missing data); volume and speed are kept
definition.hours: Finnish local hours 0-23 (no DST change inside April-September)
